scope: Read-only review of root-authored v4 plan HTML, protocol JSON and paper HTML: formulas, evaluation, denominators, identification, topic connection, response tolerance and result-status language. Own numerical benchmark files were not modified.
reviewer_independence: Reviewer authored the separate numerical benchmark. This report reviews the root-authored documents; it is not presented as independent authorship review of that numerical code.

required_clarifications.finding: The documents allow an absolute sum-one error of 1e-6 but describe U(w_star)-U(w) only as a loss. A raw vector accepted within that engineering tolerance need not lie exactly on the simplex; its direct objective gap can therefore be slightly negative. The evaluator already retains the raw vector and flags budget-residual explanations, but the reviewed document text does not explain this connection.
required_clarifications.mathematical_reason: For d=w-w_star, U(w_star)-U(w)=gamma/2*d.T@Sigma@d-gradient_U(w_star).T@d. At a simplex optimum gradient=lambda*1-nu, so the boundary term contains -lambda*(sum(w)-1)+nu.T@w. The nonnegative-loss claim applies to exactly feasible w. A serialization budget residual can change the raw sign.
required_clarifications.required_change: State that accepted raw weights are never renormalized; report raw budget residual, signed raw objective gap, and counts/flags of small negative gaps explained by the equality-multiplier budget allowance. Do not silently clip a negative gap to zero or claim it beats the constrained optimum.

required_clarifications.finding: The general both-valid wording does not fully specify which responses must be valid for an institution loss, an institution-pair response error, and an R4-minus-R1 policy comparison. These require different masks. Arm-specific valid-case averages must not be subtracted and called a paired effect when their case sets differ.

required_change.institution_within_arm: L(t,gamma,arm) requires that one final portfolio to be valid; report the valid denominator and all scheduled final cases for its failure rate.
required_change.institution_paired_policy_delta: L_R4-L_R1 requires both R1 and R4 final portfolios for the same t,gamma to be valid.
required_change.institution_pair_within_arm: E(t,gamma_i,gamma_j,arm), D and G require both institutional responses in that arm to be valid.
required_change.institution_pair_paired_policy_delta: E_R4-E_R1 (and paired D/G contrasts) requires all four final responses: two mandates times two policies. Use this same common mask for both policies.
required_change.reporting: Show planned, completed, valid and excluded counts for each estimand; distinguish final-case failures from stage-call failures. Keep asymmetry in failure rates visible and do not impute fake utilities.

minor_improvements.finding: The prose calls the risk penalty a volatility cost. The displayed expression penalizes portfolio variance w.T@Sigma@w, not its square root.
minor_improvements.suggested_change: Describe it as a risk cost proportional to portfolio variance, while retaining the accessible nontechnical explanation.

passed_checks.result: The main outcome is warranted institution-specific mandate response, not answer variety alone. E compares the signed vector of cross-mandate allocation changes with its normative counterpart; institution-specific utility gap is evaluated jointly. This connects an economic delegation question with a workflow-policy intervention.

E=0 can coexist with a common allocation error shared by all mandates; the protocol already requires joint inspection of institution-specific L and failures, so common errors are not automatically treated as success. G alone is explicitly descriptive, not a welfare test.
gamma={1,3,5}, U=mu.T@w-gamma/2*w.T@Sigma@w and full investment agree across documents and selected benchmark. Monthly decimal excess-return units preserve the meaning of the gamma values.

The original Salcher quadratic problem permits shorts. The documents explicitly label the long-only combination with PortBench precedent as a LIBERA adaptation and do not claim a unified published replication.
The documents correctly use direct objective differences and explicitly avoid reusing the unrestricted pure-quadratic distance identity.
Positive-definite covariance and positive gamma imply strict concavity and a unique optimum for each mandate. The documents correctly allow the three unique optima to coincide across mandates.
All 625 windows are retained and target-based same/distinct/unresolved strata are planned, without outcome-based market selection.
720-60-36+1=625; 625*3=1875 institution cases. Last training interval 2016-01 through 2020-12 is consistent with retaining the existing 60/36 eligibility frame.
The future 36-month block is reserved only for corpus eligibility. The main model and oracle use training moments only; current revised vintage is distinguished from historical point-in-time data.
625*3*2=3750 main final portfolios; four responses per main run yield 15000 planned response calls. FRESH adds 1875, totaling 16875. These are planned execution counts, not independent samples.
The overlapping-window corpus is not treated as iid; no independent-sample p-values, standard errors or power claim are asserted.
R1 versus R4 is explicitly a bundle of onset, position, context age and subsequent use opportunities, not a pure timing or anchoring mechanism. FRESH is a separate one-step diagnostic.

The documents prohibit gamma-bearing IDs, other institutions answers and oracle tables in model inputs. Before mandate onset a pending allocation is allowed and intermediate outputs are not scored against a missing institution objective.
No causal effect of common-model adoption, actual RAG retrieval, real-fund private information, realized profitability or financial stability is claimed by this fixed-model mandate experiment.

The paper front matter, abstract, method and conclusion explicitly state that AI responses/results do not yet exist. Protocol results.ai_runs=0 and model.runtime_ready=false agree. Prepared numeric optima are consistently distinguished from observed AI performance.
